gloss: obvious; transparent (of a motive or lie)

definitions.explanation: Of a motive, lie or trick: so plain that anyone can see through it. Always critical.

examples.japanese: ⟦{下心|したごころ}→下心：27220_shitagokoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{見|み}え{見|み}えだ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: Your ulterior motive is plain to see.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{優|やさ}しく→優しい：02640_yasashii⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{借|か}りたい→借りる：00532_kariru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{見|み}え{見|み}えだった。
examples.english: It was obvious that he'd suddenly turned nice because he wanted to borrow money.

notes:
Doubled ⟦{見|み}え→見える：01165_mieru⟧ (from ⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧, to be visible). Informal and conversational.
